articles.summary: Supply chain attacks are increasing across the global electronics industry. Palitronica, a Canadian technology company born from research at the University of Waterloo, is responding with a focused innovation strategy aimed at protecting critical sectors such as automotive, aerospace, and defence.
articles.title: Canadian Approach to Supply Chain Cybersecurity in the Electronics Sector

articles.summary: Silent supplier changes, hidden defects, and undocumented software drift are some of the biggest causes of field failures and RMAs in scaled drone programs. The Anvil Checkpoint gives drone manufacturers an objective way to verify whether received COTS electronics are truly equivalent to what was previously qualified.
articles.title: Hardware and Software Validation for Scaleable sUAS Production
